check_schema.description: Check that a JSON Schema is valid: against its dialect's meta-schema, with every $ref followed, and for the mistakes validators pass over in silence, such as a misspelled keyword, a format that does not exist, keywords ignored beside $ref and limits nothing can meet. description: Validate JSON data against JSON Schema, the standard for describing JSON. Check any value, or every item of a list, against a schema given as an object, text, a file or a link, in any dialect from Draft 3 to Draft 2020-12, and get each error in plain words. Check a schema for mistakes, create one from example data, look up keywords in json-schema.org's reference, and find JSON Schema tools and how much of the official test suite each validator passes. No account or API key required.
